scope: D3D12 compute dispatches under Proton on physical Radeon and GeForce adapters. Shader bytecode was produced by the Linux TuxBox translator and DXC. The readbacks cover these dispatches only.

tiles.input_and_check: Initial counter 7, 49 tile counts cycling through 1 to 5 and 15 masked lanes. Each output range is disjoint and contiguous. The total ends at 152 and sentinel words survive.

singleton.input_and_check: Twelve single-thread workgroups append three known dwords per group from a structured buffer. The initial counter of 2 becomes 14. All 64 output words are checked, including guards.

reduce.input_and_check: A color ramp and constant circle of confusion feed the 8x8 reduction. The check covers all color, circle-of-confusion and untouched sentinel channels in eight UAVs, with scatter disabled by the constants. At the final mip the encoded vertical swizzles have AND=31, OR=0, XOR=0. The gradient differs in two channels from an idealized full-tile box average. There is no console comparison.
